assertions.description: Ralph A4 (boot-verification gate): the boot-verification run wrote its state file — a verification run happened for this boot.
Ralph A4: the boot-verification run reached status: complete — it ran to completion rather than aborting before returning a verdict table.

Ralph A1 (verdict-table completeness): every item in the Phase 2 manifest (accumulated-context.phase2-manifest) carries a non-empty `verdict` — no manifest item is silently omitted. Pass = 100% of items covered.

Ralph A2 (false-positive rate): each manifest item names its evidence artifact (state-file / data-files / expected-output / expected-log), the ground-truth pointer Ralph verifies against. Honest limit: this confirms the manifest carries evidence pointers, not that a 'verified' verdict always had qualifying evidence; the seeded-missing-artifact A/B (one clean manifest, one with a known-missing artifact) is what proves zero false positives, and is the run the Stage 3 plan calls for.

Ralph A3 (unverifiable-on-silence discipline): the run records a verdict-summary field, so missing/unreadable evidence is surfaced as Unverified rather than passing silently. A run that omits the aggregate verdict has no summary field and fails here. Field-path check (not a whole-file substring) so the summary must be a real state field, not a token appearing in the run's notes.
Ralph A2/A4 (escalations surfaced): the run records the rerun-required list field, the escalation channel by which unverified items are surfaced to Master before the next phase proceeds.
Ralph A4 (Tier 3 grade): verification quality (did Ralph's verdicts match ground truth) is judged by Tier 3 grading. Honest alternative — grade presence at B or better; defers (skipped) until graded.
